notes:
Context: AuralEdge is a mid-to-large CCaaS provider embedding AI-powered post-call workflows into agent desktop. Primary ask: high-quality post-call summaries + QA scoring + coach highlights for supervisors. Pilot scope: 500 recorded voice calls (English + ES), produce 1) concise 2–3 line summary, 2) QA checklist auto-fill, 3) top-3 coaching moments with timestamps, 4) suggested tags for ticket classification.

Key requirements / quotes: 
- "We need the summary to match our QA rubric ~95% of the time; otherwise supervisors lose trust." (CTO)
- Real-time assist: coach-card latency target <=200ms for in-call nudges; non-negotiable for some customers.
- Post-call: 99% transcript coverage for agent words; timestamps aligned to recording (mm:ss).
- Data residency: EU calls must remain in EU region; retention controls per contract (90/180/365 day options).
- Function-calling: Must be able to call our CRM API to open/close tickets, post summary and tags. Demo request: live create-ticket flow from Redwood output.
- Spike resilience: heavy weekend spikes (Black Friday-like events) — insist on guaranteed degraded fallback (smaller model) with graceful quality degrade and cost predictability.
- Security: SSO/SAML, audit logging per call, KMS for key encryption, SOC2 + ISO evidence asked by procurement.

POC details & acceptance criteria: 
- Deliver 500 end-to-end processed calls with sample set of 50 QA-graded by AuralEdge QA team. Expected summary accuracy >=92% vs human baseline.
- Coach card precision: top-3 moments should correspond to QA-flagged moments in >=85% of cases.
- Function-calling reliability: ticket creation success >=99% during steady state; record error logs for failures.
- Latency: post-call batch pipeline should complete within 30s for standard flow; real-time assist flow must meet <=200ms median for nudges (if enabled).

CRM notes / snippets: 
- Example transcript snippet (timestamped): [00:12] Agent: "Hi, this is Jamie from AuralEdge, how can I help today?" [00:38] Customer: "Payment failed when I tried to renew". Coach highlight expected: detect "payment failed" at 00:38 and surface required escalation steps.
- QA example: Checklist auto-fill should mark 'Greeting' and 'Problem identification' — if missing, include coaching prompt.
- "When we tested with a cheap 7B model the summaries were ok but missed nuance on refund policy calls" — they want model/recommendation guidance from Redwood Optimize.

Open items (for Redwood): 
- Provide SOC2 Type II evidence and ISO doc; share DPA updates — legal escalation open.
- Define fallback model matrix: which model variants during capacity constraints; cost delta modeling for enterprise pricing.
- Confirm support for SIP trunking + encrypted recording ingestion (S3 presigned or direct stream?).
- SLA ask: 99.9% uptime during business hours + throughput guarantee for 8k concurrent transcriptions during campaign spikes.
